# nest-routes.txt is the A-class REST route inventory asserted by
# TestAllGoCutoverRoutesAreOwnedByGo. It is generated from the T1 ownership
# audit (docs/refactor/cutover/ownership-audit.md §2.1) at baseline dcbe563b.

# 审计并同步 docs/refactor/cutover/ownership-audit.md 与本文件；动态段写
